newsitem.title: USA: Texas spot power holds steady, forward months jump.
newsitem.headline: Texas spot power holds steady, forward months jump.

text.p: Spot wholesale electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) were mostly steady Friday with foreward months making a strong jump in line with higher natural gas prices, sources said.
Temperatures through the state were forecast to drop next week from current mild levels, with below and much-below levels seen from Dec 17 to 21.

ERCOT firm, peak power for a 16-hour block for weekend and Monday delivery was pegged steady at $31.00-32.00, while non-firm peak power was pegged steady at $27.00-28.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the brokers and marketers said.
Firm off-peak ERCOT power transactions were pegged steady at $11.00-13.00, while non-firm off peak ERCOT power was assessed unchanged at $9.00-11.00, the sources said.
ERCOT January/February peak power prices were said to have jumped to $34.00-34.50 from $31.50-32.00 on Thursday, the sources said.
